use_case: Pipeline leak-detection anomaly model: scores 1-minute pressure, flow, temperature, and valve data by pipeline segment and alerts controllers to possible leaks
vendor_or_model: Anomaly model vendor (machine learning anomaly detection with mass-balance features), tuned on 18 months of company historian data; runs in the company's cloud tenant
data_categories: SCADA historian data (pressures, flows, temperatures, valve states); no personal information
affects_individuals: No (indirectly: people living and working along the pipeline)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. The controller treats each alert as a prompt to check SCADA and, if needed, dispatch field staff; the model cannot send anything to SCADA
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 192.615(a)(12) (rupture identification procedures must name information sources); 49 CFR 192.631(c), (e)(5), (f), (h) (controller information, workload, change management, training); 192.705 and 192.706 remain the required patrol and leakage survey methods; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy claims, indirect)
